description: This file defines the ARM Core CMSE API for Cortex-M23/M33 CPUs, providing functions and macros for memory protection, security attribution, and access permission checks related to MPU, SAU, and IDAU regions.

methods.name: arm_cmse_mpu_region_get
methods.description: Returns the MPU region number for a given address, or -EINVAL if invalid.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address is readable under current MPU permissions.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address is readable and writable under current MPU permissions.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address range is readable under current MPU permissions.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address range is readable and writable under current MPU permissions.

methods.name: arm_cmse_mpu_nonsecure_region_get
methods.description: Returns the non-secure MPU region number for a given address.

methods.name: arm_cmse_sau_region_get
methods.description: Returns the SAU region number for a given address.

methods.name: arm_cmse_idau_region_get
methods.description: Returns the IDAU region number for a given address.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_is_secure
methods.description: Determines if an address belongs to a secure region.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_nonsecure_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address is readable from non-secure state.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_nonsecure_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address is readable and writable from non-secure state.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_nonsecure_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address range is readable from non-secure state.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_nonsecure_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if an address range is readable and writable from non-secure state.
